[EN] Once you've got a design, you'll need to buy your materials! Always wait until you have your design, though—you don't want to spend gold on the wrong thing!

That said, what can I get for you?
[ES] ¡Una vez que tengas un diseño, tendrás que comprar tus materiales! Sin embargo, espera siempre a tener tu diseño; ¡no querrás gastar oro en lo equivocado!

Dicho esto, ¿qué puedo conseguirte?
